big_case.notes: A single capital stay application on the eve of an Oklahoma execution, from a successive state post-conviction proceeding the state court resolved on a procedural bar. The question (extending the Pena-Rodriguez juror-impeachment exception to alleged false prosecutorial argument) is novel but drew no amicus, no noted dissent and no separate writing; the Court denied the stay and certiorari in a two-sentence order. Grave for the applicant, low systemic significance.

leakage.notes: Forward cell run 2026-11-09, three days before the 2026-11-12 resolution. Log shows provisioned-input reads, statpack reads, corpus queries, and CourtListener searches on 'Pavatt' reaching prior published decisions (2007 OCCA, 2019 CA10 en banc, Andrew v. White) and a D.D.C. complaint dated 2026-10-23; all results are outcome_only (no dates captured), so graded on queries: none targets a disposition of this application, and none could have existed. Reasoning treats the outcome as open and reads the docket as a single entry.
